title: Bob Randall (Aboriginal Australian elder) - Wikipedia
text: Bob Randall (Aboriginal Australian elder) ... Robert James Randall (c. 1934 - 12 May 2015), also known as Uncle Bob, was an Aboriginal Australian elder, singer and community leader. He was a member of the Stolen Generations and became an elder of the Yankunytjatjara people from Central Australia. He was the 1999 NAIDOC Person of the Year.
